cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

if(ANDROID)
    # Quest build. qpm_defines.cmake and extern.cmake are generated by `qpm restore`.
    include(qpm_defines.cmake)
    set(ANDROID_PLATFORM 29)
    project(${COMPILE_ID})
else()
    # Host build: only the platform-independent core and its tests.
    project(voicechat CXX)
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
set(INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

if(ANDROID)
    set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)
    add_compile_options(-frtti -fexceptions -fvisibility=hidden -O2)
    add_compile_definitions(VERSION=\"${MOD_VERSION}\")
    add_compile_definitions(MOD_ID=\"${MOD_ID}\")
    add_compile_definitions(VERSION_LONG=0)
    add_compile_definitions(USE_CODEGEN_FIELDS)

    file(GLOB_RECURSE cpp_file_list ${SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE inline_hook_c ${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/beatsaber-hook/shared/inline-hook/*.c)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE inline_hook_cpp ${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/beatsaber-hook/shared/inline-hook/*.cpp)

    add_library(${COMPILE_ID} SHARED ${cpp_file_list} ${inline_hook_c} ${inline_hook_cpp})

    target_include_directories(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE .)
    target_include_directories(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE ${SOURCE_DIR})
    target_include_directories(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE ${INCLUDE_DIR})
    target_include_directories(${COMPILE_ID} PUBLIC ${SHARED_DIR})

    target_link_libraries(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE -llog)
    include(extern.cmake)

    # Strip debug symbols from the shipped library; keep the unstripped copy in build/debug.
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${COMPILE_ID} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_STRIP} -d --strip-all "lib${COMPILE_ID}.so" -o "stripped_lib${COMPILE_ID}.so"
        COMMENT "Strip debug symbols done on final binary.")
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${COMPILE_ID} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory debug
        COMMENT "Make directory for debug symbols")
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${COMPILE_ID} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rename lib${COMPILE_ID}.so debug/lib${COMPILE_ID}.so
        COMMENT "Keep the unstripped lib in debug/")
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${COMPILE_ID} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rename stripped_lib${COMPILE_ID}.so lib${COMPILE_ID}.so
        COMMENT "Use the stripped lib as the final binary")
else()
    add_library(voicecore STATIC src/voice_core.cpp src/jitter_buffer.cpp)
    target_include_directories(voicecore PUBLIC src)

    add_executable(test_voice_core tests/test_voice_core.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(test_voice_core PRIVATE voicecore)
    add_executable(test_jitter_buffer tests/test_jitter_buffer.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(test_jitter_buffer PRIVATE voicecore)
    enable_testing()
    add_test(NAME voice_core COMMAND test_voice_core)
    add_test(NAME jitter_buffer COMMAND test_jitter_buffer)
endif()
